categories.main_business_segments: MetaAge Digital Co., Ltd. primarily operates as an ICT solution provider focusing on the distribution, sales, and integration of information and communication technology products. Its core business segments include managed service provider (MSP) services, AI applications, cybersecurity solutions, cloud computing, and digital integration services. The company acts as a value-added distributor for over 50 global IT brands, offering comprehensive IT infrastructure, cloud, AI, and security solutions to enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as cloud computing (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), AI and machine learning for intelligent operations (AIOps), cybersecurity frameworks including zero trust architecture (ZTA) and secure access service edge (SASE). It develops proprietary platforms like the CloudMan MSP management system and Cloud Lab private cloud environment for IT management, security monitoring, disaster recovery, and technical training. Integration of AI-driven threat detection and automated IT operations are key production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: MetaAge serves primarily enterprise customers across various industries in Taiwan and internationally, including small to large enterprises requiring IT infrastructure, cloud services, AI-driven business intelligence, and cybersecurity. Its end markets include sectors such as manufacturing, retail, finance, government, and education. The company collaborates closely with local system integrators and resellers to reach end users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operating region is Taiwan, with significant sales concentrated in northern Taiwan, including Taipei and Hsinchu, as well as central and southern Taiwan. It also has overseas subsidiaries and investments in markets such as the United States and South Africa, supporting international clients and expanding global competitiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: MetaAge operates primarily as a midstream value-added distributor and service provider in the ICT supply chain. It acts as an intermediary between upstream global IT product manufacturers and downstream system integrators, resellers, and end users. The company adds value through technical integration, consulting, managed services, and after-sales support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening MSP services, expanding AI applications, and enhancing cybersecurity offerings. R&D initiatives include optimizing the CloudMan MSP platform, expanding MetaMatch cloud marketplace for ISV integration, developing AI-driven intelligent decision-making tools, and advancing MDR and MSSP cybersecurity services. Sustainability and green IT solutions are also emphasized, with investments in low-carbon technologies and renewable energy integration.
categories.revenue_model: MetaAge generates revenue primarily through product sales of IT hardware and software from global brands, value-added services including system integration, consulting, and managed IT services. It also earns recurring revenue from subscription-based cloud services and MSP contracts, as well as licensing and support fees related to AI and cybersecurity solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading professional ICT solution provider in Taiwan’s information services market, distinguished by its extensive portfolio of global brand partnerships and integrated service capabilities. Competitors include other value-added distributors and MSP providers in Taiwan, as well as logistics-focused distributors. MetaAge differentiates through its comprehensive MSP and AI integration, strong technical support, and broad market coverage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, MetaAge reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$18.38 billion, representing a 7% decrease from the previous year. The company maintains a stable asset base of over NT$13.4 billion with a solid cash position of NT$1.38 billion. Despite a slight decline in profitability due to overseas subsidiary losses, the company continues to invest in R&D with expenditures of NT$74 million and plans steady growth through innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MetaAge emphasizes its role as a trusted ICT partner offering one-stop, integrated solutions combining world-renowned IT brands with proprietary platforms and expert technical services. Its value proposition lies in delivering high-value-added services such as 24/7 MSP support, AI-driven operational intelligence, and comprehensive cybersecurity solutions that enhance enterprise IT efficiency, security, and digital transformation capabilities. The company’s strong channel partnerships and commitment to sustainability further differentiate it in the competitive landscape.
